prompt:
Locked-off camera, no camera movement. The small woman in the canary-yellow coat stands on the bank steps facing the lens, other hand on her hip. From the first frame she mimes holding a dainty invisible slice of cake between thumb and finger, little finger out, raises it to chin height and stops dead; then she drops it, and she raises one gloved index finger upright beside her face and wags it side to side, left, right, left, right, in a steady tick-tock on the beat, the clear universal gesture for "no", her head giving a small matching shake, mock-stern and sure of herself, wagging it to the very end of the shot. She moves with swagger and attitude the whole time: chin up, a loose bratty shoulder roll, never stiff. Her canary-yellow balaclava is one smooth, seamless knitted dome over her whole head and face: plain canary knit with only the white ring and the red triangle on it, the knit lying flat and still over her face the whole time.

Thanks.
